question: m15
q: Which of Sydney's commercial centres has the busiest Fridays relative to midweek right now, and which the quietest?

transcript.answer:
**Busiest Friday relative to midweek: Chatswood, at 1.03 in September 2026.** Its Friday evening tap-ons are about 3% above the Tue–Thu average, the only centre above 1.0 that month. Strathfield is level at 1.00.

**Quietest: North Sydney, at 0.74 in September 2026.** Friday evenings run about 26% below midweek.

The full September 2026 ranking, highest to lowest:

| Centre | Friday / Tue–Thu |
|---|---|
| Chatswood | 1.03 |
| Strathfield | 1.00 |
| Parramatta | 0.81 |
| Sydney CBD | 0.78 |
| Macquarie Park | 0.77 |
| North Sydney | 0.74 |

The measure compares 3pm–7pm tap-ons on Fridays with the Tue–Thu average. A value of 1.0 means no Friday dip. September 2026 is the latest month published, so October isn't included yet.

Month-to-month readings are noisy, so treat the ranking as a guide. Chatswood has been at or above 0.95 in most months since late 2025, and its September figure is its highest in the period shown. North Sydney has stayed in the 0.69–0.76 range throughout.
